summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded firmware experience in bare-metal C on STM32 microcontrollers, FreeRTOS, and UART/I2C/SPI. Built interrupt-driven motor control with quadrature encoder feedback at 15 kHz PWM and sensor-integrated hand-motion systems.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable hand-gesture glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands in Python.
Implemented a tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design and PCB fabrication.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition in a laboratory environment; used GitLab for version control.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 firmware in bare-metal embedded C on an STM32 microcontroller (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1), achieving 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles (4-bit A/B transition state machine) and drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM on Arduino Due with Cytron motor drivers.
Built closed-loop heading correction from dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR), feeding angular error back into rotation PWM to hold course during translation.
Added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect; owned wiring and integration across mechanical teams.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to an STM32 over UART; implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) to reach 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials); gripper closes on dual VL53L0X ToF contact detection at 25 mm via a TCA9548A I2C mux.
Implemented two-link IK in C++ on Arduino driving five servos, linked to a Jetson controller over a unified WebSocket fabric.
